descriptionZh: 命运工坊是免费、无广告、无需注册的在线占卜与命理工坊，提供塔罗、黄历、八字等文化体验工具。
descriptionEn: Fate Atelier is a free, ad-free, no-signup workshop for tarot, Chinese almanac, BaZi, and related cultural tools.

sectionsZh.heading: 我们是谁
paragraphs: 命运工坊（Fate Atelier）把多种传统与现代占卜玩法放在同一个网页里：塔罗、抽签、解梦、星座黄历、八字紫微、择日风水等，全部可在浏览器内直接体验。
产品定位是「文化体验与自我反思」，不是专业命理事务所或医疗/金融咨询。

sectionsZh.heading: 你能期待什么
bullets: 免费使用核心玩法，无广告、无需注册
结果与历史默认保存在本机浏览器
功能页旁会说明简化演算或随机抽取的口径

sectionsZh.heading: 开源
paragraphs: 项目在 GitHub 开源，欢迎提 issue 与建议。我们会持续打磨可信边界、留存闭环与 SEO 内容质量，而不是盲目堆新玩法。

sectionsEn.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Fate Atelier gathers traditional and modern divination play in one browser workshop: tarot, fortune sticks, dream guides, horoscope, Chinese almanac, BaZi, Zi Wei, timing tools, and more.
We are a cultural experience and reflection product—not a professional consulting firm, and not medical, legal, or financial advice.

sectionsEn.heading: What to expect
bullets: Core tools are free, ad-free, and require no account
Results and history stay in your browser by default
Feature pages state when results use simplified rules or random draws

sectionsEn.heading: Open source
paragraphs: The project is open on GitHub. We prioritize trust boundaries, completion loops, and content quality over adding more tools for their own sake.

descriptionZh: 说明命运工坊各类结果如何生成：随机抽取、日期确定性生成，以及传统文化规则的简化版本。
descriptionEn: How Fate Atelier results are produced: random draws, date-stable generation, and simplified traditional rules.

sectionsZh.heading: 三种结果机制
paragraphs: 不同玩法使用不同生成方式。阅读结果时，请先看清它属于哪一类。
bullets: 随机抽取：塔罗抽牌、竹签抽取等，每次结果独立，用于打开新视角。
日期确定性：星座运势、部分每日灵感等，同一天同一输入通常保持一致，便于复访对照。
规则简化版：黄历、八字、紫微、奇门等，采用传统文化符号与简化演算，属于「文化体验版」，不是天文级精确排盘。

sectionsZh.heading: 为什么同一天结果可能不变
paragraphs: 对运势类内容，我们刻意使用日期种子，让你今天上午看到的句子下午仍在，方便反思而不是追逐刷新。
这不等于「真实星象此刻的精确计算」，只是产品设计上的稳定性。

sectionsZh.heading: 数据与本地性
paragraphs: 演算与解读默认在浏览器完成。历史、收藏与工坊记录保存在本机存储；我们不为这些本地记录提供云端账号同步。

sectionsZh.heading: 内容编辑原则
paragraphs: 详情页（牌义、梦象、签文）强调可区分的含义、适用情境与行动建议，并标注内容口径为娱乐与文化参考。
文案会持续润色；sitemap 的更新时间尽量跟随内容源文件，而不是每次构建全体刷新。

sectionsEn.heading: Three result mechanisms
paragraphs: Different tools produce results differently. Know which kind you are reading.
bullets: Random draws: tarot cards and fortune sticks open a fresh angle each time.
Date-stable generation: daily horoscope and some daily cues stay consistent for the same day and input so you can revisit them.
Simplified traditional rules: almanac, BaZi, Zi Wei, and Qi Men use cultural symbols with simplified logic—an experiential edition, not astronomy-grade charting.

sectionsEn.heading: Why same-day results may stay stable
paragraphs: For outlook-style content we intentionally seed by date so the morning line is still there in the afternoon—useful for reflection, not for refresh gambling.
Stability is a product choice, not a claim of live precise celestial calculation.

sectionsEn.heading: Data locality
paragraphs: Computation and interpretation run in the browser by default. History, favorites, and journal entries stay in local storage; there is no cloud account sync for those records.

sectionsEn.heading: Editorial principles
paragraphs: Detail pages (card meanings, dream symbols, stick readings) aim for distinct situations, misreads to avoid, and concrete next steps, always framed as entertainment and cultural reference.
Copy is revised over time; sitemap lastmod prefers content source dates instead of stamping every URL on each deploy.

descriptionZh: 命运工坊如何处理本地数据与分析：默认不上传占卜内容；匿名使用统计默认开启，可在本页关闭。
descriptionEn: How Fate Atelier handles local data and analytics: readings stay local by default; anonymous usage stats are on by default and can be turned off here.

sectionsZh.heading: 本地优先
paragraphs: 抽牌、解签、解梦、排盘等结果与历史，默认写在你的浏览器本地存储中，不会为了「保存账号」而强制上传。
清除站点数据或更换设备后，本机记录可能消失，请自行备份重要内容。

sectionsZh.heading: 分析与埋点
paragraphs: 默认情况下，我们会使用 Vercel Analytics 等匿名访问统计，记录页面进入、完成与分享等产品事件，以便改进工坊。
统计字段仅含事件名与玩法标识等非个人标识信息；不用于识别真实身份，也不会把牌面原文或梦境全文作为云端档案保存。
你可在本页下方关闭「匿名使用统计」。关闭后不再加载 Analytics，也不会发送产品事件。若浏览器开启 Do Not Track，且你尚未手动选择偏好，我们也会默认关闭统计。

sectionsZh.heading: 第三方
paragraphs: 网站可能加载字体或托管服务商的基础基础设施。请同时参考托管方的隐私政策。

sectionsZh.heading: 联系我们
paragraphs: 如对隐私有疑问，请通过联系页或 GitHub issue 告诉我们。

sectionsEn.heading: Local first
paragraphs: Draws, readings, charts, and history are stored in your browser by default. We do not require an account upload to “save your profile.”
Clearing site data or switching devices may erase local records—back up anything important yourself.

sectionsEn.heading: Analytics
paragraphs: By default we use anonymous product analytics (for example Vercel Analytics) for events such as page enter, complete, and share so we can improve the workshop.
Events carry page/feature identifiers only—not personal identity—and card or dream text is not kept as a cloud archive.
Use the control below to turn anonymous analytics off. When off, we do not load Analytics or send product events. If Do Not Track is enabled and you have not set a preference, analytics stay off.

sectionsEn.heading: Third parties
paragraphs: Fonts or hosting infrastructure may load from providers. Please also review their privacy policies.

sectionsEn.heading: Contact
paragraphs: Questions about privacy are welcome via the contact page or a GitHub issue.

descriptionZh: 命运工坊内容仅供娱乐与文化体验，不构成医疗、法律、金融或其他专业建议。
descriptionEn: Fate Atelier content is for entertainment and cultural experience only—not medical, legal, financial, or other professional advice.

sectionsZh.heading: 娱乐与文化体验
paragraphs: 本站所有占卜、运势、命理与择吉结果仅供娱乐、自我反思与传统文化体验。
请勿将结果作为医疗诊断、法律意见、投资决策、人事任免或其他重大决定的唯一依据。

sectionsZh.heading: 简化演算
paragraphs: 黄历、八字、紫微、奇门等功能采用简化规则与产品化评分，与专业馆所的精确排盘可能不同。详见「演算与内容方法」。

sectionsZh.heading: 责任限制
paragraphs: 在法律允许的范围内，因使用或无法使用本站内容而产生的任何直接或间接损失，作者与贡献者不承担责任。

sectionsEn.heading: Entertainment & cultural experience
paragraphs: All readings, outlooks, charts, and timing cues on this site are for entertainment, self-reflection, and cultural experience.
Do not treat them as medical diagnosis, legal counsel, investment advice, HR decisions, or the sole basis for any major choice.

sectionsEn.heading: Simplified methods
paragraphs: Almanac, BaZi, Zi Wei, and Qi Men use simplified rules and productized scoring that may differ from professional charting. See Methodology for details.

sectionsEn.heading: Limitation of liability
paragraphs: To the extent permitted by law, authors and contributors are not liable for any direct or indirect loss arising from use of—or inability to use—this site.

descriptionZh: 通过 GitHub 与命运工坊维护者联系：反馈问题、内容勘误与合作建议。
descriptionEn: Reach Fate Atelier maintainers on GitHub for bugs, content fixes, and collaboration ideas.

sectionsZh.heading: 反馈渠道
paragraphs: 欢迎在 GitHub 仓库提交 Issue：功能建议、文案勘误、无障碍问题或安全相关报告。

sectionsZh.heading: 响应预期
paragraphs: 我们是小型开源维护节奏，会尽量回复，但无法承诺即时客服。紧急安全问题请在 Issue 标题标明。

sectionsEn.heading: How to reach us
paragraphs: Please open a GitHub issue for product ideas, copy corrections, accessibility notes, or security reports.

sectionsEn.heading: Response expectations
paragraphs: We maintain this as a small open-source project and will reply when we can, without promising instant support. Mark urgent security issues clearly in the title.
